high_level_description: The image showcases an electric bike developed by students from Hyderabad's KL University. The bike is prominently displayed in the center of the image, with a sleek design featuring a white frame and black components. The brand name "greyp" is visible on the side of the bike. The text above the image reads: "Students from Hyderabad's KL University Develop Electric Bike with Wireless Charging." This indicates that the innovation involves wireless charging technology, which is a notable feature of the bike.
